# NYC Panache Salon

> Luxury hair salon in Forest Hills, Queens NY. Specializing in balayage, highlights, keratin smoothing, hair extensions, nails, waxing, and bridal styling. Owned by master stylist Marina Iskiyaeva with over 25 years of experience.

## Business Information

- **Name:** NYC Panache Salon
- **Owner:** Marina Iskiyaeva (Founder & Master Stylist, 25+ years experience)
- **Address:** 107-12 71st Road, 2nd Floor, Forest Hills, NY 11375
- **Phone:** (718) 575-0532
- **Website:** https://www.nycpanachesalon.com
- **Booking:** https://www.vagaro.com/nycpanachesalonforesthills/services
- **Neighborhoods served:** Forest Hills, Rego Park, Kew Gardens, Middle Village, Jackson Heights, Astoria, Queens, Manhattan

## Hours

- Monday: Closed
- Tuesday – Saturday: 10 AM – 7 PM
- Sunday: 10 AM – 5 PM

## Signature Services & Pricing (starting prices)

- Wash & Cut: from $45
- Wash, Cut & Blow-Dry: from $70–$85
- Touch-Up Roots: from $70
- Single Process Color: from $120
- Highlights — Full Head: from $250
- Balayage — Full Head: from $250
- Air-Touch Balayage: signature technique, starts at $250
- Ombre: $250–$350
- Keratin Complex Smoothing: from $300 (lasts 3–5 months)
- ProAddiction Smoothing Treatment: from $350 (next-generation, formaldehyde-free)
- Hair Extensions: by consultation only
- Bridal / Updo Styling: custom quote
- Waxing: Eyebrow $15+, Upper Lip $10+, Full Face $45+, Bikini $40+, Full Leg $60+
- Manicure: $15 | Pedicure: $33 | Gel Manicure: $45+
- Wedding Makeup: from $250

## What Makes NYC Panache Salon Different

- 25+ years of continuous craft from owner Marina Iskiyaeva
- Air-touch balayage: a signature technique where a blow-dryer separates fine hairs before painting for a hyper-natural, dimensional result
- Color corrections are a house specialty
- Every service includes a detailed consultation — no templates, fully custom plans
- Premium, salon-exclusive products only; hair-health first philosophy
- Free consultation for extensions and bridal services
- Luxury atmosphere without attitude — warm, welcoming environment

Cash, all major credit & debit cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay.

## Policies

- Walk-ins welcome; appointments preferred
- 24-hour cancellation notice requested
- Late cancellations or no-shows may be subject to a fee
- Prices listed are starting points — final pricing depends on length, texture, and thickness
